name: Contact Form Application
description: A comprehensive contact form application showcasing NetPad's key capabilities: multi-page forms, conditional logic, advanced workflows, MongoDB integration, and intelligent routing
summary: Production-ready contact form with intelligent automation and data management

inputs.description: Type of inquiry (general, product, support, sales, partnership, feedback, other)

outputs.description: MongoDB document ID of the saved submission
Whether confirmation email was sent to the contact

sideEffects.description: Saves form submission to MongoDB collection
Sends email notifications based on inquiry type and urgency

events.name: submission.created
events.description: Emitted when a new contact form submission is created

events.name: submission.routed
events.description: Emitted when submission is routed based on inquiry type

events.name: notification.sent
events.description: Emitted when notification emails are sent

instructions.import: This application demonstrates NetPad's comprehensive capabilities including multi-page forms with conditional logic, sophisticated workflows with MongoDB integration, and intelligent email routing. Perfect for learning NetPad's advanced features.
setup: 1. Import the template bundle using the NetPad import API or UI
2. Configure your MongoDB connection in Settings → Connections
3. Configure your email integration in Settings → Integrations (SMTP or SendGrid)
4. Update email addresses in the workflow configuration:
- urgent@example.com → Your urgent inquiry alert email
5. Update the form ID in the workflow trigger node
6. Update the connection ID in the MongoDB write node
7. Update the credential ID in all email-send nodes
10. Test the form submission and verify workflow execution
features: Multi-page form wizard with progress indicator
Conditional field visibility based on inquiry type
Section headers for organized form layout
Multiple field types: text, email, phone, dropdown, radio, checkbox, number
Form validation with min/max length, patterns, and required fields
Workflow with conditional routing based on urgency and inquiry type
Data transformation node for data normalization
Multiple email notifications with intelligent routing
